conventions.decision: AI full-text eligibility recommendation, distinct from final human/formal inclusion.
conventions.read_extent: Eligibility requires sufficient full-text evidence for every criterion, not independent verification of every proof, appendix or codebase. Inspected extent and version are specified per record.
conventions.features: Only feature_codes fields are verified in this checkpoint. Other legacy feature codes remain provisional. No means not demonstrated in the inspected evidence/version; Partial requires the stated limitation.
conventions.uq: Image UQ includes deterministic sets and posterior variability; it does not imply calibrated probabilities. Operator UQ requires uncertainty for operator parameters, not image variance caused by uncertain physics.
conventions.access: Nine PDFs and one public full-article XML source were retrieved. Acquisition flags mean local PDF acquisition. No paper content is redistributed; versions and hashes record provenance.
conventions.c1: The unchanged 2020–2026 window applies. Official proceedings or explicitly identified preprint/journal versions are inspected; final-version equivalence is not assumed.
conventions.c5: Every assessed record had an accessible English full text at source_url.
conventions.provenance: No reproducible database search or undocumented discovery date is inferred from this targeted batch.
conventions.categorical_operator_uncertainty: P071 Q=Partial records predicted degradation-type probabilities used for filter mixing. It does not establish a posterior over physical parameters or calibrated probabilities. P013 O=Partial denotes an explicit latent degradation representation only.

records.title: All-in-One Image Restoration for Unknown Corruption
records.technical: AirNet learns a latent degradation representation and conditions restoration on it. This earns partial degradation inference, not physical-operator recovery. Its combined-task tables pool separate corruptions; they do not test compound corruption per observation. Spatially varying noise is evaluated.
records.applicability: Useful all-in-one baseline; spatial noise transfer is narrower than unseen corruption-family evaluation.
quality_followups: Do not infer physical parameter estimation from latent embeddings or compound observations from pooled-task training; inspect separate supplements before broader claims.

3.evidence: Blind restoration of unknown corruption with a spatially varying noise test.

records.title: Differentiable Uncalibrated Imaging
records.version: arXiv 2211.10525 v3, 20 December 2023; final journal text not compared.
records.read_extent: §II.A–C; §III setup and selected angle/noise experiment on PDF pp. 3–6; joint coordinate results and §IV on pp. 9–10.
records.technical: Continuous measurement representations and acquisition coordinates are fitted jointly under a nominal inverse/forward construction. Simulated CT tests perturb angles and detector coordinates with measurement noise. Coordinate estimates are point estimates; instrument calibration is not evaluated probability calibration.
records.applicability: Operator perturbation comparator with simulated acquisition, rather than captured CCTV.
quality_followups: Match initialization and noise-specific pretrained networks; audit iteration selection because coordinate error can increase through overfitting.

records.title: Uncertainty-Aware Fourier Ptychography
records.version: Published Light: Science & Applications 2025 article; PMC/Europe PMC full-text archive.
records.read_extent: Introduction and Results; Discussion including simulated noise/bit-depth tests; Materials and methods, Eqs. 1–12 and Algorithm 1. Supplementary files not audited.
records.technical: UA-FP jointly optimizes the object, illumination misalignment and pupil aberrations with differentiable physics and regularization. Captured microscopy and synthetic noise/quantization tests support robustness. Its uncertainty parameters are deterministic estimates; image/operator distributions and probability-coverage calibration are not demonstrated.
records.feature_locator: Materials and methods, Eqs. 2/12 and Algorithm 1; Results spectrum-removal test; Discussion
records.applicability: P/Q/R now supersede provisional positive uncertainty/calibration codes; spectrum-removal evidence is only partial detail validation.
quality_followups: Check supplementary assumptions and target fidelity; do not generalize spectrum-extension examples into universal recovery guarantees or reuse percentage ratios of PSNR as linear gains.

records.title: Model Adaptation for Inverse Problems in Imaging
records.version: arXiv 2012.00139 v2, 12 April 2021 (title page 14 April); final IEEE TCI text not compared.
records.read_extent: §2; §§3.1–3.2; §§4.1–4.5 selected setup/results including Tables 1–2; §4.8 and §5 (PDF pp. 4, 6–11, 14, 17–18).
records.technical: P&P fine-tunes pretrained reconstruction weights; R&R uses a pretrained reconstruction as regularization. Unknown parameterized operators can be optimized jointly. Deblurring, super-resolution and simulated MRI experiments test changed acquisition maps. Weight adaptation and PSNR variation do not provide calibrated uncertainty.
records.applicability: Existing adaptation comparator; MRI measurement experiments are simulations, despite using medical source images.
quality_followups: Separate known-operator and jointly estimated cases, validation tuning and compute; do not extrapolate simulated MRI results to clinical performance.

records.title: Training Adaptive Reconstruction Networks for Blind Inverse Problems
records.version: arXiv 2202.11342 v3, 18 December 2023 (title page 19 December); final SIAM text not compared.
records.read_extent: §3.1–3.2; §4.1–4.2 and Proposition 1; §5; §6.1, selected §6.2 comparisons and §6.3; §7 (PDF pp. 6–9, 11–14, 17–19).
records.technical: Operator-family training supports unrolled reconstruction and test-time point estimation of acquisition parameters. Simulated MRI/CT calibration improves, but blind optical deblurring collapses to the narrowest kernel. The MMSE argument assumes ideal representation and optimization; it is not a coverage guarantee.
records.applicability: Training operator distributions is established; it does not imply posterior operator uncertainty.
quality_followups: Treat the reported blur-kernel collapse as a required comparator failure test; distinguish enlarged parameter ranges from unrelated acquisition families.

records.title: Real-World Video Deblurring: A Benchmark Dataset and an Efficient Recurrent Neural Network
records.version: arXiv 2106.16028 v2, 15 October 2022; expanded IJCV-style manuscript, final journal text not compared.
records.read_extent: §3; §4.1–4.2; §5.1–5.2 selected results; §5.4–5.5 selected cross-dataset/noise tests, Table 8; §6 (PDF pp. 4–8, 10, 12–16).
records.technical: ESTRNN combines recurrent features with neighbouring-frame attention; BSD supplies synchronized real blurred/sharp videos. Cross-dataset tests expose asymmetric synthetic-to-real transfer and acquisition-noise effects. Changing blur is observed across frames, without explicit physical-operator tracking or uncertainty estimates.
records.applicability: Useful paired-video benchmark; artifact comparisons are qualitative, not calibrated detail-support tests.
quality_followups: Respect sequence-disjoint splits, exposure synchronization and target limitations; the paper’s cross-validation is dataset transfer, not k-fold uncertainty estimation.

records.title: S3-CLIP: Video Super Resolution for Person-ReID
records.version: arXiv 2601.08807 v1, 13 January 2026; final WACV workshop report not compared.
records.read_extent: §3.1–3.3; §4 setup/results and failure cases, Table 1/Figure 2; §§5–6 (PDF pp. 3–8).
records.technical: S3-CLIP trains SwinIR reconstruction with recognition features and temporal loss. Real surveillance tests show direction-dependent retrieval gains and failures with blur/compression. Ground-to-aerial rank-1 improves while overall mAP falls; recognition improvement does not verify recovered image detail.
records.applicability: Include as task-driven restoration evidence, not as proof of physical reconstruction fidelity; compound evidence is qualitative.
quality_followups: Audit directional sample imbalance and normalization differences; temporal consistency is not time-varying operator estimation, and retrieval accuracy is not forensic truth.

1.evidence: arXiv 2601.08807 v1, 13 January 2026; final WACV workshop report not compared.

2.evidence: Super-resolution is explicitly trained with reconstruction/perceptual/temporal losses and its degradation failures are evaluated; recognition is the downstream endpoint.

records.title: Correction Filter for Single Image Super-Resolution
records.version: Official CVPR 2020 proceedings PDF; the older preprint is not the assessed source.
records.read_extent: §3.1–3.2, Assumption 1/Theorem 2 and Algorithm 1; §4 setup and non-blind/blind tables; §5 (PDF pp. 3–6, 8).
records.technical: A correction filter maps mismatched low-resolution observations towards the bicubic distribution expected by pretrained super-resolvers. The blind variant estimates a kernel through reconstruction consistency. Its exact-recovery motivation requires a linear-subspace assumption expressly acknowledged as invalid for general natural images.
records.applicability: Established observation-correction baseline; blur plus subsampling is compound acquisition, with no compression experiment asserted.
quality_followups: Check noise/boundary sensitivity and kernel-estimation failures; blind tables contain regressions despite broad improvement language.

records.title: All-in-One Image Restoration for Unknown Degradations Using Adaptive Discriminative Filters for Specific Degradations
records.technical: ADMS predicts degradation-type probabilities to mix sparse task-specific filters. Partial O/Q reflect categorical degradation weights, not physical-parameter posteriors. Synthetic-to-real examples are qualitative. Most tasks are pooled separately; the snow dataset explicitly combines haze and snow.
records.applicability: Do not erase soft categorical predictions, or upgrade them into calibrated operator uncertainty.
quality_followups: Distinguish task pooling from the compound snow/haze subset; no classifier calibration or physically supported-detail guarantee is established.

records.title: Upscale-A-Video: Temporal-Consistent Diffusion Model for Real-World Video Super-Resolution
records.technical: Upscale-A-Video adds temporal diffusion layers and flow-checked latent propagation. Text/noise controls trade fidelity against texture generation. Synthetic compound and real-video tests are reported; real tests lack ground truth. Flow rejection controls propagation, not whether reconstructed detail is released.
records.applicability: Image-UQ and temporal-operator codes remain provisional; temporal coherence alone establishes neither.
quality_followups: Audit inherited degradation settings and total pretrained compute; readable generated text and no-reference metrics do not certify source detail.

2.evidence: Image reconstruction/restoration is central to the inspected method or benchmark.
